body: Adversarial review round 14 (codex): the projection try/catch in lib/plan.mjs logs any error as a warning, so a legacy .adlc/tickets.json that appears after the late assertNoLegacyTicketStore (cross-process race) is thrown by writeAdlcTickets and swallowed, letting compilePlan succeed with no ticket-store projection. Fix: the catch rethrows errors with code LEGACY_TICKET_STORE (decision isolated in an exported pure predicate projectionErrorIsFatal so it is unit-testable, since the window is not deterministically reproducible), every other projection error stays a warning. Add tests: predicate true only for LEGACY_TICKET_STORE; and compilePlan source of the catch uses it. Acceptance: npm test green; rails untouched.
title: compilePlan must not downgrade LEGACY_TICKET_STORE to a warning
